metadata.title: EF-REG-007 Connected decision failure leaves source record unmodified

payload.script: const body=document.body.innerText||''; const row=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,div')).find(el=>/EFREG007-DecisionFail/i.test(el.innerText||'') && /Approve|Reject|Request rework/i.test(el.innerText||'') && (el.innerText||'').length<1800); if(!row) return {found:false,hasText:/EFREG007-DecisionFail/i.test(body),url:location.href}; row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return {found:true,text:(row.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,1200),top:row.getBoundingClientRect().top,height:row.getBoundingClientRect().height};

payload.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'Approvals' navigation item in the LEFT sidebar under the MANAGER section, directly below 'New Expense' and above the FINANCE section; it is the connected approval queue route, not the dashboard content.

The medium-sized Comments textarea inside the LEFTMOST visible Approval card for EXP-1028 / EFREG007-DecisionFail-EFQA-20260924T1300, in the CENTER-LEFT area below the card's 'Comments' label and above its Reject/Request rework/Approve buttons; this is the target card's field, not a neighboring card's textarea.

The small red 'Reject' button in the LEFTMOST visible approval card for EXP-1028 / EFREG007-DecisionFail-EFQA-20260924T1300, in the CENTER-LEFT area directly below the target card's Comments textarea and to the left of its Request rework button; this is not the Reject button on any neighboring Rahul Mehta card.

payload.script: const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,div')).filter(el=>/EFREG007-DecisionFail/i.test(el.innerText||'')&&/Task #101647442/i.test(el.innerText||'')&&(el.innerText||'').length<2200); const card=cards[0]; if(!card) return {found:false,url:location.href}; const text=(card.innerText||'').trim(); const ta=card.querySelector('textarea'); return {found:true,url:location.href,record:'EFREG007-DecisionFail-EFQA-20260924T1300',status:text.match(/Pending Approval|Approved|Rejected|Needs Rework/)?.[0]||null,task:(text.match(/Task #[0-9]+/)||[])[0]||null,comment:ta?.value||null,error:(text.match(/The decision could not be recorded[\s\S]{0,180}/)||[])[0]||null,hasDecider:/Decided by|DecidedAt|Decided By/i.test(text),hasDecisionTimestamp:/Decision timestamp|DecidedAt|Decision date/i.test(text),cardText:text.slice(0,1600)};

payload.elementDescription: The small underlined 'Open expense' link in the LEFTMOST visible approval card for EXP-1028 / EFREG007-DecisionFail-EFQA-20260924T1300, below the red friendly error and above the Reject button in the CENTER-LEFT area; this is the target card's detail link, not the Open expense link on the neighboring card.

payload.script: return {url:location.href,path:location.pathname,detail:(document.body.innerText||'').split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).filter(s=>/EXP-1028|EFREG007-DecisionFail|Pending Approval|Manager approval|Waiting on a manager|decision could not be recorded|unchanged|Decided|Comment/i.test(s)).slice(0,40),inputs:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea')).map(el=>({type:el.type,id:el.id,value:el.value})).filter(x=>x.value)};
